question: The number 966181 is divisible by which of the following?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The given number is 966181.

Since the unit digit of the number is 1, it is an odd number.

An odd number can never be perfectly divided by an even number (such as 36 and 38) or a number ending in zero (such as 30).

By eliminating options 36, 38, and 30, the only possible divisor is 37.

**∴ The correct answer is 37.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The number is 966181.

**Method Used:**

Check divisibility by observing basic properties and performing division.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us test each given option for divisibility.

⇒ Option 1 (36): Since 36 is an even number, its multiples must also be even. 966181 is an odd number, so it is not divisible by 36.

⇒ Option 2 (38): Similarly, 38 is an even number. Thus, 966181 is not divisible by 38.

⇒ Option 3 (30): A number divisible by 30 must have 0 as its unit digit. Since 966181 ends in 1, it is not divisible by 30.

⇒ Option 4 (37): Let us divide 966181 by 37.

⇒ 966181 ÷ 37 = 26113

⇒ Since it divides perfectly leaving a remainder of 0, 966181 is exactly divisible by 37.

**∴ The correct answer is 37.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by Even Numbers

No odd number can ever be exactly divided by an even number because an even number always contains 2 as a prime factor, which is inherently absent in all odd numbers.

Divisibility by 10 and its Multiples

Any integer that is perfectly divisible by 10 or its multiples (like 20, 30, 40) must inherently have its unit digit as 0.

Special Divisibility by 37

Any 3-digit number formed by repeating the same digit three times sequentially (e.g., 111, 222, 555) is always exactly divisible by 3 and 37.
